decisions.reason: As a very recently launched product with its own webpage, it reflects a visible public commitment and sunk investment, so management is likely to continue it and view any early weakness as temporary.

Although the firm has committed less visibly to this product than to A, it is still a new 2023 launch and a small established German manufacturer would likely persist for now rather than quickly reverse course.

This product appears less prominently promoted and is therefore somewhat easier to cut, but its recent launch means prior investment and the tendency to justify the launch still make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
